summary: 1stdibs.com, Inc. filed an 8-K on May 11, 2026 announcing its Board authorized a $10.0 million share repurchase program. The program allows open-market purchases, privately negotiated transactions, Rule 10b5-1 plans, accelerated repurchases, block trades, or derivative contracts under Rule 10b-18. No expiration date or minimum share obligation is set; timing and volume depend on market conditions and securities laws. This is a discretionary capital-return initiative, not a fixed-price tender. Watch the pace of buybacks for signaling; no premium or closing date applies.
